title: Azusawa Kohane — In My Own Words〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I couldn't sleep and decided to come here...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I still can't believe An's dad said he'd start watching our practices.)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm doing some cleaning.
I was just putting away all the cups...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Putting them away...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: That's right. I'm thinking about closing this place down for a little while.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
You've all made your decision.
Which is why I'm going to do what I can to honor that.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: It's what I owe you for keeping the truth from you for so long...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I don't know what our practices are going to be like, but I do know that I'll need to do my best to hang in there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Because we told Taiga that we'd surpass RAD WEEKEND and see what's waiting for us beyond that!
You really have changed so much, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: M-Miku?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Um, hang on...
D-Did you hear everything I just said...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, but I wasn't trying to eavesdrop.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But you heard...!
*Sob*
I feel so embarrassed...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Don't be. That was some good determination.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But you feeling embarrassed just showed me that some of your old self is still there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My old self...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Back then, I had no confidence in myself, and didn't have any real interests...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A small part of me wanted all that to change, but I was never able to muster up the courage to actually act.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And look at you now, skipping school to give Taiga a piece of your mind.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know it's not good to cut class...but I don't regret going over to see him one bit.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Because you didn't want to leave any loose ends.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Remember when you told An and me how this SEKAI is made up of our feelings?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I even asked you and MEIKO if this place really is made of “our” feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I remember.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I had to ask because I didn't have a dream like An.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Now, I can confidently say that I do.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My dream is to put on an event with An and the others that surpasses RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which is why I know for sure now that this is our SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: As one who watches over your feelings from this SEKAI, it's wonderful to see you making such big strides.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: At the same time...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We want to see you do more. Much more.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
We're singers, Kohane.
So, let's have our singing do the talking.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Tell me how you feel right now. Give me everything you have.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay!
Then, Miku, I want you to listen carefully.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Miku's been by my side this entire time.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Whenever I felt like giving up, she was always there to make sure I never lost sight of my true feelings.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Whenever I started losing confidence in myself, she sang with me, encouraged me and pushed me to keep moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (So, I want to tell her...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (How much she means to me...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And everything I'm capable of with my singing now!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh wow...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Miku's never heard me sing this song before, but we're harmonizing so well!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This must mean that she understands how I feel, and what I'm trying to do with this song.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Thank goodness...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Singing really is fun.)
